title: No git helper emits a bare `^` under PowerShell
question_or_target: Does any git invocation pass a caret-bearing revision (`tag^{commit}`, `HEAD^`) unquoted through PowerShell? PASS requires zero such call sites and a live check that tag-to-commit dereference returns the correct object under pwsh7.

evidence.claim: Independent reviewer verified the artifact at command-center/receipts/TST-0188.json exists on disk (23575 LF-normalized bytes), parses as JSON, carried the builder terminal state=BLOCKED with failure.classification=[reviewer-absent] and reviewer=null (no self-certification) at review time, and its report.kind=shell_report matches the catalog output_schema pin.

evidence.claim: Independent reviewer re-ran both named probes live for 3 rounds each under the ambient environment; all exited 0 with the unit SUCCESS sentinel (probe1_static_and_hazard.py=3/3 rounds rc0; probe2_second_shell.py=3/3 rounds rc0); live sentinels match the builder-recorded raw_output lines (consistent=True).
